Raised by grandparents who cared deeply for children in their community, he grew up witnessing the power of love, stability and guidance. That early grounding shaped his belief that every child deserves a father who shows up, both emotionally and spiritually.As he continued volunteering, he saw one heartbreaking pattern emerge repeatedly: fatherlessness. It was this realisation that led him to the Centre for Fathering and eventually to the Singapore Prison Service, where he now supports incarcerated fathers through workshops, open visits and reunification activities. Seeing their fears, hopes and determination to reconnect with their children motivates him to keep showing up week after week.Bramsha's volunteerism allows him to journey alongside fathers from all walks of life, especially those who are currently incarcerated or have been released. He holds the firm belief that when a father chooses to grow, reflect, and reconnect, it changes not just his life but his child's future too, and that is why he serves. caption: This festive season, we would like to invite you to step aboard our first-ever Roving Art Gallery at , launched yesterday by our Guest-of-Honour, Associate Professor , Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs and Senior Minister of State, Ministry of Home Affairs, as we shine a light on the gift of second chances, hope and family.Have an up-close look at the inspiring Star Light, Star Bright paintings that were created by incarcerated mothers together with their children, as part of our Star Light, Star Bright initiative, in partnership with and .While you are there, you can pledge your support for the initiative by voting for your favourite paintings, and receive a complimentary set of limited-edition Star Light, Star Bright greeting cards. These artworks were crafted by inmate-artists, each reflecting their own passage towards reconciliation with their families. As we celebrate this season of giving, you can also purchase festive cookies from Yellow Ribbon Bakery as festive gifts onsite. These exclusive cookie bundles come in limited-edition packaging featuring the Star Light, Star Bright paintings.
